currency: USD unless marked €; taxes/store/regional pricing may differ
method: Official product/pricing pages and current upstream READMEs, browsed and/or fetched directly. Features are vendor/project claims unless separately measured. Unknown means not established, not absent.

products.name: Wispr Flow
plans: Unlimited dictation; longer meeting history; shared vocabulary, workspace, billing and analytics.
$23/user/month; page also shows $33 with unlimited Notetaker
SAML, multiple domains, organization privacy policies. Annual comparison shows $18/user/month; confirm add-on selection.
SCIM, audit logs, MDM, domain capture, IT-admin seats, contract and support.
Eligible students: $0/year per official help page
products.routing: Managed service; checked sources do not establish a general local/BYOK mode.
products.difference: Strong integrated writing/meeting workflow and organization controls. Current official pages disagree on some free limits and plan labels.
products.notes: Pricing page still lists 2,000 desktop / 1,000 mobile words per week in its comparison; plan language is changing. Recheck checkout. Security certifications are vendor claims, not an OSpr audit.

products.name: Superwhisper
plans: Unlimited local Whisper dictation; vocabulary and text replacements; two modes without AI processing. 3,000-word Pro trial.
Cloud/local Pro models, AI modes, context awareness, real-time transcription, system audio, speaker separation, file imports and BYOK.
Same Pro features; one license across unlimited Macs/Windows PCs and iOS/Android devices.
Same Pro feature set with one-time billing.
Centralized authentication/billing, model policies and enterprise hosting; verify contract.
products.routing: Local and hosted ASR/LLM choices; BYOK in Pro.
products.difference: Configurable modes and app context make it a close dictation-workflow reference.
products.notes: Official billing docs explicitly list all three Pro prices. Verified students/educators and nonprofits can request 40% off before purchase. Website and App Store pricing can differ. Official changelog documents segmented history playback and word timestamps.

products.name: VoiceInk (Beingpax)
plans: Source available; commercial purchase supports distribution/updates.
Team toggle exists; current team total not established.
products.routing: Local recognition; optional text enhancement through chosen provider.
products.difference: Native local dictation with app/URL modes, custom words, replacements, selection edits and journaling.
products.notes: Distinct from similarly named voice-ink.com and unrelated VoiceInk repositories. Requires macOS 14.4+ per current vendor page. The current repository README requires macOS 15.0+, differing from the checked vendor minimum; confirm the selected build.

products.name: MacWhisper
plans: Basic local transcription and limited export.
One-time, lifetime updates; premium transcription and workflow features.
Hosted Assistant, App Store and iOS purchases can differ; not inferred from desktop Pro.
products.routing: Local models, BYOK cloud providers, custom compatible endpoints, Ollama/LM Studio.
products.difference: Broad media-workflow reference: speaker recognition, app audio, watched folders, subtitle/video editing, CLI and automation.
products.notes: Some web tables lose checkmark alignment in text extraction; exact Free/Pro gating should be confirmed in the native product. UI was not benchmarked. Official shortcuts document audio playback and playback-speed control.

products.name: Aqua Voice
plans: Unlimited words, custom instructions and expanded dictionary.
Max plus SSO/SAML, SCIM, reporting, ZDR and team dictionaries.
products.routing: Cloud dictation; offline availability varies by platform/version/mode per FAQ.
products.difference: Context-aware technical dictation and a distinct realtime tier. Computer-action and agent integration broaden the scope beyond text entry.
products.notes: Direct fetch of current pricing was used because web search also surfaced older Team/Business structures. No independent latency claim.

products.name: Willow
products.platforms: Mac, Windows, iOS; Android marked coming soon
plans: Unlimited Frontier Mini; limited personalization; 20 Scribe uses/week.
Frontier Pro, personal writing memory, unlimited Scribe, longer turns.
Enforced privacy, HIPAA controls, admin features.
products.routing: Managed transcription and writing service.
products.difference: Personalized style memory plus intent-to-writing Scribe. The current free tier differs from older 2,000-word reviews.
products.notes: Plan security language is vendor-provided. Source does not establish a bring-your-own-key or general offline mode.

products.name: Spokenly
plans: Unlimited offline Whisper/Parakeet; BYOK cloud and realtime.
Recording styles, settings sync, priority support; hosted usage excluded.
Managed cloud ASR and AI cleanup; monthly switch exists but monthly total not resolved.
products.routing: Local-only mode, free BYOK or managed hosted models.
products.difference: Aggressive free local/BYOK offering; realtime engines and agent workflows raise the baseline OSpr must meet.
products.notes: Local+ purchase availability differs for the direct Mac build versus the App Store version.

products.name: Typeless
products.platforms: Mac, Windows and mobile; check platform matrix
plans: Limited words; writing cleanup, translation, dictionary and app-specific tone.
Unlimited words, enhanced accuracy/priority, sync and team management.
SSO, SCIM, audit/retention, domain controls and agreements.
products.routing: Managed service; local history does not itself establish local ASR.
products.difference: Personalization, intent cleanup, translation and whisper-style input bundled into one writing flow.
products.notes: Do not equate “on-device history” with on-device inference. Exact free quota is not specified in the checked page.

products.name: SpeechPulse
plans: Current and future updates; up to six personal computers on the purchased platform.
Up to six Macs and six Windows PCs for one named user.
products.routing: Offline speech and optional local/API LLM templates.
products.difference: Hands-free endpointing, spoken punctuation, word training, file diarization and subtitles make it a useful power-user reference.

products.name: Voibe
plans: Limited words, one device, punctuation, vocabulary and history; 7-day full trial.
Unlimited dictation; local or cloud mode; developer features.
Meetings, summaries, chat and PDF export.
products.routing: On-device dictation or ZDR cloud; meeting audio uses cloud processing per pricing FAQ.
products.difference: Separates dictation from a broader meeting workspace. Local transcript storage and cloud meeting processing are distinct.
products.notes: Earlier $198 lifetime references are stale relative to this checked page. BAA availability is vendor-provided, not verified by OSpr.

products.name: Voicetypr
products.license: Public source; consult current repository license
plans: 1/2/4 activation choices; other totals require checkout.
products.routing: Offline Whisper/Parakeet; optional cloud ASR and BYOK text cleanup.
products.difference: LAN offload to a stronger machine, per-app rules, CLI/API and file workflows are useful adjacent features.
products.notes: Public source is not treated as proof of the current binary license or unrestricted free distribution.

products.name: Monologue
plans: 1,000 words and 10 recorded notes, including offline/context features.
Unlimited dictation, notes and bot-free meeting notes.
Other Every products/newsletter included in bundle.
products.routing: Vendor advertises offline transcription.
products.difference: Apple-device continuity and integrated notes/meetings; a polished setup and context flow matter as much as the ASR model.

products.name: Handy
products.routing: Fully local ASR; optional post-processing is configured separately.
products.difference: Tauri/Rust app with hold/toggle shortcuts, history, paste methods and a broad model catalog. Current docs recommend Cohere for quality and Parakeet for speed.

products.name: OpenWhispr
plans: Unlimited local/BYOK; hosted 2,000 words/week and 5 meeting hours/month.
Unlimited hosted dictation, 20 meeting hours, agent mode, sync, API/MCP.
products.routing: Local or hosted inference, including self-hosted endpoints.
products.difference: Broadest open-source product reference in this sample: meetings, local diarization, notes/search, sharing, agent actions and enterprise controls.

products.name: TypeWhisper
plans: Check binary distribution and plugin terms separately.
products.routing: Swappable local engines and cloud APIs.
products.difference: Native Swift reference with reusable workflows, dictionary/snippets, recovery, raw restore, undo, file inbox and sync. Stable 1.7 differs from development 1.8.

products.name: OpenWhisp
plans: No account/subscription; optional cloud text processing.
products.routing: On-device Parakeet/Whisper and local rewrite.
products.difference: Streaming-oriented native dictation and a private-socket agent bridge with separate voice/history/rewrite capabilities. Its ~0.3s delay is a project claim, not an OSpr measurement.

products.name: Muesli
products.platforms: Apple Silicon macOS 14.2+; some engines need 26+
products.routing: Local by default, optional hosted transcription/cleanup.
products.difference: Native meeting-plus-dictation app with many Core ML/MLX engines, including Nemotron, Cohere, Qwen and Indic models. Notes, summaries, calendar and experimental computer control extend its scope.

products.name: FluidVoice
products.routing: Resident local Parakeet via MLX.
products.difference: Focused hold/toggle dictation with a warm daemon and deterministic vocabulary correction. It claims very low latency; OSpr did not reproduce the app timing.

products.name: Whispering / Epicenter
products.routing: Chosen compatible endpoint; local hosted endpoints possible.
products.difference: File-owned voice notes and prompt transformations. Current main README calls itself a development milestone and explicitly excludes dictation into other apps; older search results describe a different host architecture.

products.name: Whispo
products.platforms: Apple Silicon Mac and Windows x64
products.routing: BYOK OpenAI/Groq ASR; custom endpoint and LLM post-processing.
products.difference: Small hold-to-talk and automatic-paste reference. Local storage is documented; general on-device recognition is not established by the checked README.

products.name: Vibe
products.routing: Offline Whisper-based transcription.
products.difference: Media-first application rather than a comprehensive dictation replacement. Useful reference for file input, language handling and transcript export.

products.name: Buzz
plans: Optional cloud providers have their own charges.
products.routing: Offline Whisper-family engines with multiple backends.
products.difference: Desktop file/live recording, translation, subtitles and watched-folder workflows. Engine availability and acceleration vary by platform.

products.name: aTrain
products.platforms: Primarily desktop research workflow; verify current Mac support
products.routing: Offline ASR and diarization.
products.difference: Interview transcription, speaker segmentation and qualitative-research exports. Adjacent meeting/media reference, not a system-wide dictation product.

products.name: Apple Dictation
products.routing: On-device support depends on language, hardware and settings; check Keyboard settings.
products.difference: Zero-install input baseline with native keyboard integration. General dictation is separate from full Voice Control and newer SpeechAnalyzer APIs.

products.name: whisper.cpp
products.routing: Metal/Core ML/CPU/Vulkan and other hardware backends.
products.difference: Deployment/runtime baseline with quantization, VAD and persistent-server options. OSpr directly benchmarks the Metal server, not every app built on it.

products.name: WhisperKit / Argmax OSS
plans: Argmax Pro SDK is a separate commercial product.
products.routing: Core ML-based on-device inference.
products.difference: Swift-native Whisper plus SpeakerKit diarization. Pro-only capabilities and models must not be counted as open-source WhisperKit features.

products.name: MLX Audio / Swift
products.routing: MLX GPU inference with a broad speech-model catalog.
products.difference: Useful model-adapter base for Qwen, Nemotron, Voxtral, Cohere and more. A conversion must match its runtime; a model repository name alone does not prove compatibility.
